emergence.summary: PTS encodes 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin synthase, the second (committed) enzyme of de novo tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) biosynthesis from GTP. Loss-of-function collapses the BH4 cofactor supply. BH4 is the obligate cofactor of THREE aromatic-amino-acid hydroxylases -- phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH), tyrosine hydroxylase (TH) and tryptophan hydroxylase (TPH) -- so BH4 deficiency produces (a) hyperphenylalaninaemia, the SAME accumulating metabolite as classic PKU but arising from a COFACTOR lesion rather than the PAH apoenzyme, AND (b) central monoamine-neurotransmitter (dopamine, serotonin) depletion that PKU does NOT cause, giving a severe encephalopathy with dystonia/seizures historically called 'malignant hyperphenylalaninaemia'. This is read as an enzyme/LOF lowering BH4-supply throughput -> the cofactor-supply axis is pushed DOWN, so the corrective direction RESTORES it. The kit re-derives the approved lever: supply the missing cofactor exogenously -- sapropterin (synthetic BH4, Kuvan, FDA 2007) -- which HERE acts to REPLACE the deficient cofactor itself. This is the elegant 'one drug, two lever roles' contrast to PKU, where the SAME sapropterin acts instead as a CORRECT / chaperone arm stabilising residual PAH apoenzyme (BH4 is not the lesion there). Because BH4 deficiency ALSO starves TH and TPH, the read adds a monoamine-replacement arm -- L-dopa + carbidopa and 5-hydroxytryptophan -- that PKU never needs. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only (firewall); the coding lesions are outside the promoter firewall and every magnitude is held [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) cofactor supply (PTPS enzyme switch) -> aromatic-amino-acid hydroxylation (phenylalanine clearance) + monoamine-neurotransmitter (dopamine/serotonin) synthesis -- a cofactor-supply axis

per_gene.note: PTS encodes 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin synthase, the committed (rate-limiting) step of de novo BH4 biosynthesis (GTP -> dihydroneopterin triphosphate -> 6-pyruvoyl-tetrahydropterin -> BH4). Biallelic LOF (PTPS deficiency, the commonest BH4-synthesis defect, ~60% of BH4-deficient hyperphenylalaninaemia) abolishes BH4 supply, so EVERY BH4-dependent hydroxylase loses its cofactor -> phenylalanine accumulates (as in PKU) AND dopamine/serotonin synthesis fails. As a deficient ENZYME the pathway throughput falls and the cofactor-supply axis goes DOWN, so the corrective levers RAISE it. Autosomal recessive, 11q23.1 (OMIM 261640). NCBI official symbol PTS. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; the coding lesions are outside the promoter firewall.

falsifiers.claim: PTS LOF lowers BH4 cofactor supply -> hyperphenylalaninaemia AND monoamine deficiency (cofactor-supply axis DOWN)
falsifiers.falsifier: a PTPS-deficiency allele that left BH4 levels and phenylalanine / dopamine / serotonin handling normal would refute the cofactor-loss direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: urinary and CSF pterin profile (neopterin/biopterin), plasma phenylalanine, and CSF HVA and 5-HIAA (dopamine/serotonin metabolites) in PTPS-deficient vs control

falsifiers.claim: supplying BH4 (sapropterin) is the CORRECTIVE direction (it replaces the deficient cofactor)
falsifiers.falsifier: if exogenous BH4 failed to lower phenylalanine or to restore pterin-dependent hydroxylation, the replace-cofactor lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: plasma phenylalanine fall and CSF monoamine-metabolite response to a sapropterin (BH4) loading challenge
